## Standard

<a id="BashScripts"></a>

### Bash scripts

`BashScripts` · `src/shell.ts:20`

The marks of a script of Bash: the line that names its interpreter, the options that stop it at the first failure (an unset variable, a failing command, a failing pipe), quoting, a subshell, the parameter that refuses to be missing, the directory of the script.

Source: GNU Bash Reference Manual (5.2): § 3.1.2 Quoting, § 3.2.5 Compound Commands (subshell), § 3.5.3 Shell Parameter Expansion (${parameter:?word}), § 4.3.1 The Set Builtin; env(1) for the #! line · `https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/manual/bash.html`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `interpreter` | `#!/usr/bin/env bash` | The first line: the script is run by Bash, wherever it is installed |
| `strict` | `set -euo pipefail` | Stops at an unset variable, a command that fails, a pipe whose part fails |
| `comment` | `#` | Opens a comment, to the end of the line |
| `space` | `" "` | Separates the words of a command |
| `quote` | `"` | Around a word that must stay one word |
| `and` | `&&` | Runs the next command only when the one before succeeded |
| `open` | `(` | Opens a subshell: a change of directory in it stays in it |
| `close` | `)` | Closes the subshell |
| `cd` | `cd` | Changes the directory |
| `assign` | `=` | Gives a variable its value |
| `dollar` | `$` | Reads a variable |
| `required` | `${1:?` | Opens the expansion of the first argument that stops the script, saying the rest, when it is missing |
| `closeBrace` | `}` | Closes an expansion |
| `here` | `$(dirname "$0")` | The directory of the script, wherever it is run from |
| `separator` | `/` | Between the steps of a path |
| `endOfLine` | `"\n"` | Ends a line |

## Syntax element

<a id="ShellScript"></a>

### A script of Bash

`ShellScript` · `src/shell.ts:52` · status: **held**

The script that runs a shipment on another machine: the person who ships is its first argument, and it stops without one; it goes from its own directory to the repository's root, installs the packages of each directory of the plan, installs the generation's own packages when it has its own, runs what the packages ask once installed, each in its directory, then ships from the project with the person's name.

Section: § 3.2.5 Compound Commands; § 3.5.3 Shell Parameter Expansion; § 4.3.1 The Set Builtin · `https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/manual/bash.html#Shell-Parameter-Expansion`

| Mark | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `person` | `by` | The variable that holds the name of the person who ships |
| `usage` | `give the name of the person who ships` | What the script says when it is run without a name |
| `written` | `Written by trame ship from the graph, for the shipment` | What the script's first comment says |
| `of` | `of` | Between the shipment and its project, in that comment |
| `edit` | `Do not edit: edit the graph, then ship.` | The comment that says where to change it |

| Input | Writes | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| `{"shipment":"Preview","title":"A preview","project":"apps/poselia","command":["../../trame.sh","ship","Preview","--by"],"file":"apps/poselia/scripts/ship-preview.sh","toRoot":"../../..","installs":[".","std","apps/poselia"],"prepares":[{"dir":"std","run":"npx playwright install --with-deps chromium"}],"delivers":[{"artifact":"PageFile","path":"apps/poselia/dist/poselia.html"}],"evidence":"apps/poselia/evidence","deployed":{"command":["../../trame.sh","evidence"],"verdict":"passed","by":"--by","url":"--url"}}` | `"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Written by trame ship from the graph, for the shipment \"A preview\" of apps/poselia\n# Do not edit: edit the graph, then ship.\nset -euo pipefail\nby=\"${1:?give the name of the person who ships}\"\ncd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/../../..\"\n(cd \".\" && npm ci)\n(cd \"std\" && npm ci)\n(cd \"apps/poselia\" && npm ci)\n(cd \"std\" && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium)\ncd \"apps/poselia\"\n../../trame.sh ship Preview --by \"$by\"\n"` | held |
